name: Remit-Scout Deep Audit & Fix
description: Autonomous audit loop: document findings, then implement fixes.

userStories.title: Plane A API Routes Deep Audit
userStories.description: Audit Plane A API routes and handlers for correctness, security, and contract stability.
acceptanceCriteria: Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Focus on auth/entitlements, validation, error handling, stale/incorrect responses, and contract drift with frontend/admin consumers.

userStories.title: Plane B Collectors and Providers Deep Audit
userStories.description: Audit provider collectors/parsers in Plane B for broken logic, stubs, and data-integrity risks.
acceptanceCriteria: Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Look for parser fragility, partial-data flags misuse, retry/timeout issues, and corridor/method misclassification risks.

userStories.title: Queues and Workers Deep Audit
userStories.description: Audit queue workers, schedulers, and fanout flow for stuck states, retries, DLQ handling, and idempotency gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Focus on replay safety, duplicate processing, ack/delete behavior, circuit breakers, and queue growth controls.

userStories.title: Data Lineage and Gold Integrity Deep Audit
userStories.description: Audit Bronze/Silver/Gold lineage and index computations for silent data loss and invariant violations.
acceptanceCriteria: Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Check TEER/RVI/RCI boundaries, stale-data handling, export correctness, and reconciliation gaps.

userStories.title: Auth and Entitlements Deep Audit
userStories.description: Audit auth and entitlement enforcement paths across backend and frontend edges.
acceptanceCriteria: Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Target bypass risks, missing checks, stale role assumptions, and inconsistent auth behavior between routes/pages.

userStories.title: Frontend-API Contract Deep Audit
userStories.description: Audit frontend data calls and admin surfaces for contract mismatch and operational regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Validate loading/error states, stale assumptions about API shapes, observer/admin contract usage, and dead links/UI actions.

userStories.title: Observability and Alerts Deep Audit
userStories.description: Audit observability plumbing, alert workers, and evidence contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Look for dropped evidence, weak reason-code handling, broken emit paths, and stale SLO/MTTR data chains.

userStories.title: Infrastructure and Deployment Wiring Deep Audit
userStories.description: Audit infra/deploy wiring for drift risks, unsafe defaults, and missing production safeguards.
acceptanceCriteria: Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Focus on env-specific invariants, IAM/auth assumptions, schedule safety, and rollout/rollback coverage.

userStories.title: Configuration and Secrets Handling Deep Audit
userStories.description: Audit env/config usage and schema contracts for breakage and leakage risks.
acceptanceCriteria: Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Check documented-vs-used env vars, insecure defaults, deprecated flags, and schema/contract drift.

userStories.title: Tests and Coverage Deep Audit
userStories.description: Audit tests and test harness quality for false confidence and blind spots.
acceptanceCriteria: Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Document skipped/flaky tests, weak assertions, untested critical paths, and contract-test gaps.

userStories.title: Dead Code and Local Artifacts Deep Audit
userStories.description: Find dead/orphaned code, stale artifacts, and local-only leftovers.
acceptanceCriteria: Audited repo for unused exports/files, commented blocks, generated leftovers, and stale temporary assets
Included path, line range, severity, category, description, and code snippet for each finding
userStories.notes: Highlight cleanup candidates with operational risk, not just style nits.

userStories.title: Final Consolidation Index
userStories.description: Create a master audit index summarizing all findings and highest-risk items.
acceptanceCriteria: Created .codex/ralph-audit/audit/00-INDEX.md with summary across all audit files
Included totals by severity and category
Listed top critical findings with links back to source audit files
userStories.notes: Read all generated .codex/ralph-audit/audit/*.md reports and produce executive-level index only.
